name: agent_container_app
label: Agents
subtitle: Scoped fleet status for SciTeX agents
about: A browser projection of the scitex-agent-container host control plane. Ordinary identities see and control only their own node's agents; cross-host fleet access requires explicit, separately-listed operator authorization and is recorded in an audit trail.
description: SciTeX Agents renders the SAC host control plane (sac listen) as a server-rendered fleet dashboard under the shared scitex-ui shell. It is a projection, not a second state store: every read and lifecycle mutation goes through the committed public listener surface, and the view scopes each row to the acting identity before rendering.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: List agents visible to the acting identity (own-scope by default)
Inspect an agent's state, runtime, harness, engine/model, host and a2a reachability
Delegate start/stop/restart to the authenticated host control plane (operator-gated, audited)
